title: OrderingOrderRunningLatePayload
description: Payload of `ordering.order.running_late` version 1. An accepted, ready or on-its-way order is expected more than 5 minutes past its promise: the customer is told once, with the new time. The status does not change; told once per order however late it runs after. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's Partner and its `correlation_id` follows the order. Read the order at `GET /v1/platform/orders/{order_id}`, `GET /v1/customer/orders/{order_id}` or the store's route. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

number.description: The order's number, as said aloud.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.

previous_status.description: The status before; `null` for a first status.

version.description: The order's version after the change; it only rises, and signals carry it.

fulfilment.description: Delivery or pickup, or `on_site` for a booking's order.

currency.description: The currency of every amount, in its minor unit.

by.description: Who made the move: dispatch moves an order as the platform itself.

due_by.description: The promise: when it should have been at the door.

minutes_late.description: How many minutes past the promise.
